purpose: Two predeclared P1 k5 component-overload probes; prepare only until root review and P2 resource release
algorithm_name: P1 per-pipe overloaded components and quotient ready list
method: Build heavy/sink/bounded fallback, identify each whole component exceeding any compute-pipe fair share, peel independent suffix waves within fixed bounds, pack waves and retained components into coarse Tasks, place their acyclic quotient using a deterministic compute/gate ready-list proxy, apply bounded independent-component chunks and official structural validation. No online E0 or score search.
stop_policy: First constructor/E0/source/resource/cleanup failure stops the batch; no retry; retain remaining not_run
coordination: WAIT_ROOT_REVIEW_AND_P2_RELEASE: preparation only. P2 is preparing its 062 three-cell batch; this probe must wait for root explicit EXECUTE after review and resource release. One nonexclusive worker, no Colab/GPU; preserve actual authorization receipt.

comparison_source.scope: Exact old bounded04 same-cell plans/results and official singlecore originals reused; no baseline calls
